item.title: Gulls Secure Win Over Bakersfield Condors
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls returned from the All-Star break with a victory over the Bakersfield Condors at Dignity Health Arena tonight, 3-1. Goaltender Tomas Suchanek made his sixth appearance of the season tonight, saving 31-of-32 shots. Suchanek did not let up a goal until the final two minutes of the game, securing his second win of the season. item.title: Gulls’ Comeback Falls Short vs. Condors
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls came just short of the Bakersfield Condors tonight at Pechanga Arena San Diego, 5-4. Despite the loss tonight, the Gulls put up a tough fight and stayed on the Condors' heels throughout the entirety of the game. San Diego outshot Bakersfield 30-26 and responded quickly to three of their goals. Bakersfield got on the board first, but not long after San Diego responded. item.title: Anaheim Ducks Reassign Ian Moore To San Diego
item.description: The Anaheim Ducks announced today that the National Hockey League (NHL) club has reassigned defenseman Ian Moore to the San Diego Gulls, Anaheim’s primary development affiliate in the American Hockey League (AHL). In addition, the Gulls have assigned forward Coulson Pitre and defenseman Konnor Smith to Tulsa. item.title: Gulls Take Two Points from IceHogs
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls took a comeback win over the Rockford IceHogs tonight at BMO Center, 5-4. There was a complete team effort put up by San Diego tonight as they took home their sixth all-time win over Rockford. The Gulls responded to each of Rockford’s goals and held a lead only in the third period, which ensured their win. item.title: Gulls Fall Short of IceHogs
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls came up just short of the Rockford IceHogs today in game two of their back-to-back series at BMO Center, 2-1. After a scoreless first period, Nathan Gaucher opened the scoring one minute and 16 seconds into the middle frame. Gaucher has found seven goals this season, just one short of his total logged in 2024-25. The primary assist was credited to Matthew Phillips who has tallied four assists in his past three games.
